sloka: आचक्ष्व मे महाबाहो त्वमेनं राक्षसोत्तमम्।यं दृष्ट्वा वानराः सर्वे भयार्ता विद्रुता दिशः ।। ६.७१.२५ ।।
transliteration: ācakṣva me mahābāho tvamenaṁ rākṣasottamam।yaṁ dṛṣṭvā vānarāḥ sarve bhayārtā vidrutā diśaḥ ।। 6.71.25 ।।

translations.english: "Oh! Vibheeshana, a mighty armed one! Show me that foremost of Rakshasas, whom all Vanaras feared and fled in all directions."
